title: NEB Class 11 Mathematics — Vectors — 2024
subject: mathematics
source: NEB Grade 11 Model Questions / NEB Past Papers 2020-2024

questions.question: If a = 2i + 3j − k and b = i − j + 2k, find a·b and |a × b|.
questions.knowledgeNote: a·b < 0 means the angle between them is obtuse — the sign carries geometric meaning.

questions.question: What is the scalar triple product? Write its geometric significance.
questions.solution:
**Scalar triple product** [a b c] = a·(b × c), computed as a 3×3 determinant.

**Geometric meaning:** its absolute value is the **volume of the parallelepiped** with a, b, c as coterminous edges. [a b c] = 0 ⟺ the vectors are coplanar.
questions.knowledgeNote: Cyclic symmetry [a b c] = [b c a] = [c a b]; swapping two vectors flips the sign.

questions.question: Find the unit vector in the direction of a = 2i − 3j + 6k.
questions.knowledgeNote: 2-3-6 is a Pythagorean triple in 3D (magnitude exactly 7) — NEB's favourite integer-friendly vector.

questions.question: Find the scalar projection of a = 2i + j on b = i + 2j.
questions.knowledgeNote: Scalar projection can be negative (against b's direction); vector projection keeps the direction of b.

questions.question: Find the area of the parallelogram with adjacent sides a = 2i + j and b = i + 3j.
questions.solution:
a × b = (2i + j) × (i + 3j) = 6k − k = 5k.

Area = |a × b| = **5 square units** (triangle on the same sides: half, 2.5).
questions.knowledgeNote: Parallelogram |a×b|, triangle ½|a×b| — the half is the whole question in disguise.

questions.question: Find the angle between a = i + j and b = j + k.
questions.knowledgeNote: cos θ = (a·b)/(|a||b|) — zero dot means perpendicular, equal magnitudes simplify fast.
